description: This file defines a React component called RequireAuth that protects certain routes by checking user authentication and administrative privileges. It renders a loading message while authentication status is being determined, redirects unauthenticated users to the login page, and optionally restricts access to admins only.

methods.name: RequireAuth({ children, requireAdmin = false })
